Excellent value for money
Apr 2026 • Couples
It's a tiny place that's hardly a restaurant, but it's really delicious. To get here, you have to go through the Night Market and head straight into downtown for two minutes, the restaurant will be on the right. Exact address: 53/2 Nguyễn Thiện Thuật. There are five tables inside and a couple outside. We've been here twice and we've taken souvlaki on a plate both times, just with different meats. Everything was delicious and fresh, and finally not overcooked, overdried or sprinkled with sauce. The meat is given fresh salad and fries, by the way, very delicious and not fried in butter.

A few tweaks needed
Jan 2025 • Couples
We visited this restaurant at lunchtime. It was a popular spot and a clean interior with friendly staff. 

A few bits that were missing/improving to hit 5*’s from me: 

-Sprite & Coca-Cola were served just in their can. No glass given or even a straw. 
-Just a fork & napkin - no knives 

- My food came out with chips instead of rice as ordered. The staff did change this but I think the same chicken was used from the first dish as it was then cold when my order came out. 

Pros: 
- the staff were apologetic of the mistake in the order and brought a little complimentary dessert
- the food was quick to come out of the kitchen 
- you can pay cash or card 
- good portion sizes with fresh salad

Amazing !!! cuisine, but find this EXACT place, not a copycat!
May 2024 • Couples
Wow, their kitchen is super delicious and quite authentic! Don’t mix up this place with two copycats with a similar name on the “main” street. The right place is on a side street, 5 meters to the right from the “main” touristic street. While we were enjoying our meals, about 7 guests came to order their meals take-away. To me, it verifies the authentic and quality of their cuisine. Take an extra tsatsiki portion to enjoy your souvlaki to the fullest! The waitress was very professional and dedicated, and spoke fluent English. Highly recommend!
